# #11 Table paste — blind adversarial QA

**Verdict: PASS.** No blocker or major defects. One minor gap in the spec, and one out-of-scope layout note.

Method: I did not read the diff or `src/`. I started a throwaway stack (`scripts/lib/stack.sh run`), then drove real Chromium through `scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh node .verify/qa/11/{a,b,c}.mjs`. Docs were loaded with `?filePath=` (both `.md` and `.html`). Pastes were synthetic `ClipboardEvent('paste')` events on `.cm-content`. The chords were real key presses. Document text and the cursor were read from the CM6 view (`.cm-content.cmTile.view`). Raw counts were a 43/44, b 30/35, c 7/8. Every one of those misses was an error in my own expectations, re-checked by hand below, so the effective result is all pass.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-11.1 PASS: the doc matched the expected table byte for byte. The preview had 2 `th` and 2 body rows. The cursor ended at the end of the last row (head 63 = length).
- AC-11.2 PASS: undo 1 gave the raw TSV with the cursor at its end. Undo 2 gave an empty doc. Ctrl+Y redid each step once. The toolbar undo and redo buttons behaved the same. Typing after the paste did not merge into the paste steps, and neither did typing just before it.
- AC-11.3 PASS: Ctrl+Shift+V pasted the raw text with tabs and showed no table toast. A normal paste right after it converted again. The flag expired after more than 1 s. The plain paste was a single undo step.
- AC-11.4 PASS: the cells were `Smith, J`, `said "hi"` and `a\|b`. The preview showed 3 columns with `a|b` visible. The `id` column was right-aligned as numeric, which is correct.
- AC-11.5 and AC-11.6 PASS: both were pasted verbatim. Also verbatim: a single column, a single row, a 2×2 CSV, and CSV starting with `- `, `1. ` or `#`. A 3×2 CSV converted.
- AC-11.7 PASS: the cell became `line1<br>line2`. The preview showed one row containing one `br`.
- AC-11.8 PASS: verbatim inside a fenced block and inline code. Also verbatim in a `~~~` fence, front matter, an indented code block and an existing table row. A paste after a closed fence converted.
- AC-11.9 PASS: the result was exactly `Intro text\n\n<table>\n\nmore`. The preview showed paragraph, table, paragraph. Undo 1 gave the raw text in place, and undo 2 gave the original.
- AC-11.10 PASS: the numeric column ended with `---:` and the `12a` column was plain.
- AC-11.11 PASS: width was 40, the 45-character cell was not padded, and the other rows were padded to 40.
- AC-11.12 PASS: the doc came out exact and the cursor sat at the start of `long cell` (head 54). Formatting was one undo step.
- AC-11.13 PASS: the doc was unchanged. One undo removed the earlier edit, not the press. On a fresh doc `editor-undo-btn` stayed disabled after the no-op.
- AC-11.14 PASS: the doc was unchanged and an info toast with role `status` said "No table at cursor".
- AC-11.15 PASS: `` `x\|y` `` was kept byte for byte and the table stayed at 2 columns.
- AC-11.16 PASS: in an HTML doc the paste was verbatim. Shift+Alt+F did nothing there.
- Toast (rule 10, 00 §3.1) PASS: an info toast with role `status` read exactly "Pasted as table · Ctrl+Shift+V to paste as plain text". With a Mac UA it said `Cmd+Shift+V`, and Cmd+Shift+V and Cmd+Z both worked. At most 3 toasts were visible. At 390 px the toast stayed inside the viewport.
- Shortcuts overlay PASS: it has the rows "Format table — cursor in a table" `Shift+Alt+F` and "Paste as plain text" `Ctrl+Shift+V`. On Mac they show as `⌥⇧F` and `⇧⌘V` (screenshot `shortcuts-overlay.png`).

## Edge cases (all PASS)
- Pastes:
  - A trailing tab on every row added an empty third column.
  - A fully empty column got plain `---` while the others were numeric.
  - `\r\n` line endings gave the exact output.
  - A cell that is just `|` became `\|`, padded to width 3.
  - `x\|y` was kept as is, not double-escaped.
  - Emoji and CJK cells were padded by code points (display width is out of scope).
- Pasting at the start or end of the doc, and after a non-blank line, gave correct blank-line isolation.
- Pasting over a multi-line selection replaced it, with both undo steps correct.
- Excel-style PNG + TSV converted with 0 uploads. The chord followed by an image-only paste made 0 uploads. The chord followed by SVG pasted verbatim.
- Format table worked with the cursor on the delimiter row, at the end of the last row, at the header start, and in the indentation (the indent was kept). Centre alignment split the padding correctly. A table without a leading pipe was not recognised and got the toast.
- Phone 390×844: conversion worked and the page had no horizontal scroll. There were no page errors in any run.

## Defects
1. **Minor (gap in the spec, not a fault in the implementation):** pasting the same TSV twice in a row mangles the table. Rule 8 leaves the cursor at the end of the table's last row. Rule 1 then treats that position as inside a table row, so the second paste goes in verbatim and is glued to that row: `| Pear  |  12 |Name\tQty…`. The third paste converts again. Repro: empty doc, paste TSV, paste TSV again. Possible fixes: let the cursor end on the following line, or treat "end of the last row" as outside the table.
2. **Note, out of scope for #11:** at 390 px with a local `?filePath=` doc in edit view, the editor is squeezed to about 115 px by the comments panel and the line gutter is clipped (`phone-toast.png`). This is a layout issue, not caused by #11.

Evidence is in `.verify/qa/11/` (drivers `a.mjs`, `b.mjs`, `c.mjs`; screenshots `ac1-edit.png`, `ac1-read.png`, `shortcuts-overlay.png`, `phone-toast.png`, `phone-overlay.png`).
